in_arabic.name: فنان
in_arabic.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'f-n-n' which means 'to cover, hide, or conceal'. The name Fanan, therefore, signifies someone who is hidden, concealed, or secret. This could be a fitting name for a child whose birth was a surprise or whose true identity is kept hidden.
